technical.summary: LLY shows solid bullish technicals with price above all major MAs and rising RSI across timeframes, but moderate ADX trend strength, below-average volume, and lack of triggered strategy reduce swing entry conviction.

fundamental.summary: LLY shows no actionable smart money signals with zero insider activity, no institutional positioning data, no government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk 57 days out.

sentiment.summary: Extreme fear (11/100) presents contrarian buy opportunity; weak congressional buying from junior members offers minimal conviction support; no recent news data to confirm setup.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (348.8) with flat yield curve inversion risk, imminent CPI event in 2 days, and moderate earnings binary risk in 57 days create highly unfavourable macro conditions for LLY.
